title: Base ship template
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Defines common ship properties shared by all ship types. Physical quantities follow ADR-0008 (value+unit objects). Allowed units are defined in the central units registry (assets/json/schema/units.schema.json).

mass.description: Ship mass in kilograms. Required per ADR-0009 (every rigid body MUST have mass) and ADR-0014 (gameplay values in JSON).

inertia_scale.description: Dimensionless multiplier on the default spherical inertia tensor. 1.0 = sphere with radius 1m. Higher values simulate mass concentrated farther from center.

bounding_box.description: Axis-aligned bounding box of the mesh in ship-local coordinates (metres). Computed once from glTF mesh. Used for camera position defaults, debug axes, and spatial calculations. Min and max are opposite corners of the box.

min.description: Minimum corner (x, y, z in metres).

max.description: Maximum corner (x, y, z in metres).

propulsion.description: Propulsion system configuration. References main thruster and maneuvering thruster definitions by name. Required per ADR-0014 (gameplay values in JSON).

main_thrusters.description: Array of main thruster names (references to directories under assets/components/propulsion/main-thrusters/). For M2, exactly one thruster is active. In M3+, the player can switch between thrusters (e.g. cruise vs. combat mode).

maneuvering_thruster.description: Name of the maneuvering thruster (reference to a directory under assets/components/propulsion/maneuvering-thrusters/).

collision_shape.description: Collision shape for the ship. Defines how it interacts with other objects. Derived from bounding_box per ADR-0044.

type.description: Collision shape type. 'sphere' or 'box' are supported for M3.

radius.description: Radius of the sphere in metres (for sphere shape type).

half_extents.description: Half-extents of the box (for box shape type).

offset.description: Offset of the collision shape center from the entity origin in metres. Default (0,0,0) centers the collision shape on the entity. Use this to align the collision shape with the visual mesh when the mesh is not centered at the entity origin.

weapons.description: Array of weapon names. Each entry references a weapon definition by name.

max_weapons_count.description: Maximum number of weapons this ship can carry. Used to limit weapon selection keys. Required field - no default.

max_propulsions_count.description: Maximum number of main thrusters this ship can switch between. Used to limit propulsion selection keys. Minimum is 1 (a ship must have at least one thruster to fly). Required field - no default.

health.description: Ship health in hit points. Required per ADR-0014 (gameplay values in JSON).

vec3.description: 3-component vector (x, y, z) in metres. Each component uses value+unit format per ADR-0008.
